standard: ISO 5-3:1995, Photography — Density measurements — Part 3: Spectral conditions
note: Identical to ISO 5-3:1995 (Foreword). The values below are Table 3, page 7 (PDF p. 16), 'Status A — log10 spectral products n_A (Normalized to 5,000 peak)'.
source: ANSI/ISO 5-3-1995, ANSI/NAPM IT2.18-1996, Table 3, p. 7. US federal incorporated-by-reference copy (AIMM IT2.18:1996, 36 CFR 1238.14(d)(2)), published by the Office of the Federal Register.
units: log10 spectral product, 10 nm, normalised so each channel's peak is 5.000; a channel's relative spectral product is 10^(value - 5)
interpolation: linear in log10 between the 10 nm values; the printed edge slopes extend the log10 values outside the tabulated span
figure: Figure B.3, page 15 (PDF p. 24): the plotted Status A blue/green/red spectral products agree with these tabulated values (blue peak 440 nm, green 530 nm, red 620 nm).
